title: Mission Loadout
subtitle: Build and clear
intro.heading: Three missions. One equipment bay.
intro.body: Match the platform and sensor to each construction task. Inspect all readiness indicators, address any blocker, then decide whether the loadout can be cleared.
intro.goal: Goal: clear all three missions and score at least 80%.
bay.title: Equipment bay
bay.pickOne: Select one item in each equipment rack.
bay.selectHint: Click or use Tab and Enter to select equipment.
bay.inspectHint: Inspect each indicator. Address any blocker before clearance.
bay.positioning: Positioning awareness: confirm the setup supports the mission's location requirements.
mission.facade.label: Mission A · Façade
mission.facade.title: Close visual inspection
mission.facade.brief: Inspect a building façade visually. Controlled positioning close to the building matters; collect clear visual information.
mission.mapping.label: Mission B · Open area
mission.mapping.title: Visual site mapping
mission.mapping.brief: Map a large open construction area visually. Efficient area coverage matters; sustained hover is not the defining requirement.
mission.geometry.label: Mission C · 3D survey
mission.geometry.title: Building geometry survey
mission.geometry.brief: Survey a building and its immediate site. Controlled positioning around the building and 3D geometric information are required.
decision.help: Hold if any part is unsuitable or a readiness issue remains. Clear only when the complete setup is suitable.
feedback.incomplete: Select a platform and sensor, then inspect every readiness indicator before deciding.
feedback.held: Good hold. Review the flagged part of the loadout, correct it, then clear the mission.
feedback.unnecessaryHold: This loadout is ready to clear. Recheck your clearance judgement.
feedback.blocked: Clearance blocked. Revise the flagged part of the loadout before trying again.
feedback.ignored: This issue still needs attention. An unresolved readiness issue cannot be accepted as ready.
feedback.cleared: Mission cleared. The platform, information type and readiness now match the task.
feedback.issue.platform: Platform suitability: consider the mission's positioning and area-coverage needs.
feedback.issue.sensor: Sensor suitability: match the information requested by the mission.
feedback.issue.readiness: Readiness: inspect and address the issue before clearance.
results.heading: Loadout complete
results.explanation: Each mission awards points for platform, sensor, readiness and clearance judgement. Corrected decisions remain eligible for credit.
results.saved: Result saved. You may close this activity or replay.
